description: This source file defines the 'ActivationRebalancerOptions' class, which contains configuration options for the activation rebalancing feature in Orleans. It includes properties for timing, entropy thresholds, scaling behavior, weights, and limits, along with an internal validator class that checks the validity of these options based on certain constraints.
